title: Base-four remainder-length parameter
statement: For a finite Boolean list $x$, let $r(x)$ denote the remainder list in its binary-arithmetic decomposition. Define $h_J(x)$ to be the base-$4$ logarithm of the length of $r(x)$, rounded down to an integer, with value $0$ when that length is $0$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the binary-arithmetic decomposition or its remainder list.
